defaultActivatorRef.description: A ref to the default activator button element.

label.description: The Chip heading for the trigger

loading.description: Should the FilterPicker display the loading state.

multiSelect.description: When `true`, `FilterPicker` will allow for multiple selections

onClear.description:
Callback function invoked upon the clearing of all options.
This is only available when `multiSelect` is `true`.

onClose.description: Callback function invoked upon the FilterPicker menu closing.

onLoadMore.description: Callback to load more options, this is called when the user scrolls to the bottom of the list.

onSearch.description: Debounced callback function invoked on FilterPicker search input change. Receives the current search value as an argument.

onSearchDebounce.description: The amount of time in ms to debounce the onSearch callback. Defaults to 300ms.

onSelect.description: Callback function invoked upon the selection of an option. Provides the selected option(s) as an argument.

onSelectAll.description:
Callback function invoked upon the selection of all options. Provides the selected option(s) as an argument.
This is only available when `multiSelect` is `true`.

selected.description: The selected options of the FilterPicker.

subjectNoun.description:
The encapsulating noun for the content of the combobox. Used
in the empty state, and search placeholder. Should be pluralized.

keepOpenOnClick.description: Keeps the FilterPicker open when the action is clicked.

label.description: The label text of the action.

onClick.description: The function to call when the action is clicked.

visible.description: Determine if the action is visible for a given item.

customRender.description:
Advanced: A custom render prop to completely control how this option is rendered.
The function receives the option's props, and a boolean indicating if the option is selected.

type.name: (option: Pick<FilterPickerOptionProps, "prefix" | "id" | "label"> & { isSelected: boolean; defaultContent: ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>; }) => ReactNode

id.description: A unique identifier for the option.

label.description: The value to be visually displayed in the FilterPicker options list.

onClick.description: Callback function invoked when the option is clicked.

prefix.description: An optional component to be displayed before the label.
